subject: VPC endpoints / IP allowlist integration follow-up
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T16:03:00Z
Subject: VPC endpoints / IP allowlist integration follow-up

Hi Alice — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can keep momentum: 

1) Summary of call:
- FinPay wants private connectivity for production inference: VPC endpoints + IP allowlist + egress controls.
- Requirement for mTLS between FinPay services and Redwood VPC Endpoint; customer-managed certs preferred.
- Need to ensure DNS resolution for endpoints inside FinPay VPC and restrict outbound egress to Redwood-managed ranges.
- Interest in using Redwood embeddings + reranker for fraud scoring; will need to route embedding calls to a private model variant.

2) Action items we suggested:
- Share our VPC integration guide and mutual action plan (attached).
- Customer to provide network diagram + primary contact for networking (please send CIDR ranges and any proxy/egress appliance details).
- Schedule a technical deep dive with Jonas (networking) and Marissa (integration/SDK) — 60 minutes.

3) Questions we still have:
- Will FinPay terminate TLS at a proxy that performs TLS termination for outbound traffic?
- Do you have fixed egress IPs or will you use NAT gateways that may change?
- Any internal PKI preferences for mTLS certs (PKCS12, cert-manager, HashiCorp)?

Attachments: redwood_vpc-integration-guide.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Proposed slots for the deep dive: Wed 7/21 9–11am PT, Thu 7/22 1–3pm PT. Let me know which works and who from your infra team should join.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finpay.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Ortiz <bob.ortiz@finpay.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T00:18:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC endpoints / IP allowlist integration follow-up

Thanks Lauren — great summary. We have internal approval to proceed with a private connectivity approach. Quick answers below and attached a high-level network diagram.

- We currently use NAT gateways with static egress IPs for our production VPCs; we can provide the egress IP list.
- We do terminate TLS at an internal proxy (Envoy) but can support mTLS from the proxy to external services. Our security team prefers cert-manager-managed certs issued by our internal CA.
- We'll need 1) a list of Redwood egress IPs and 2) the required DNS names for the VPC endpoint so we can add internal DNS records.

Attached: FinPay_network-diagram.pdf

We can do Wed 7/21 9:30am PT — I will invite our infra lead (Bob) and security (cc'd).

Thanks,
Alice
Head of Infrastructure
FinPay
alice.chen@finpay.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-16T13:45:00Z
Subject: Fwd: VPC endpoints / IP allowlist integration follow-up

Lauren / Jonas — forwarding Alice's note. Notes from a quick read:

- Good that FinPay has static egress IPs; that simplifies allowlist. We need to confirm whether those IPs are per-environment (staging/prod) or aggregated.
- For mTLS: since they terminate TLS at Envoy and can originate mTLS, plan A is to accept mTLS from their proxy to our VPC endpoint. We should confirm cert formats and rotate windows.
- DNS: they want internal DNS names pointing to our endpoint; we'll provide a CNAME/DNS A record target for the VPC endpoint. We'll need to validate TTLs and split-horizon behavior.
- Embeddings/reranker routing: recommend a private model variant (dedicated pool) or an internal routing policy that pins requests with header x-redwood-routing: finpay-prod to the private fleet. We'll want to document SDK header to set.

Proposed technical owner map for the deep dive:
- Networking: Jonas Weber (CC'd) — to cover VPC endpoints, IP allowlist, DNS, egress
- Integration/SDK & Auth: Marissa Cole — SDK header routing, auth flow for private endpoints
- Solutions / PM: Lauren — stakeholder alignment and rollout plan

I'll draft a short tech checklist for the call.

-Marissa

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@finpay.com>
Cc: Bob Ortiz <bob.ortiz@finpay.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-17T18:12:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC endpoints / IP allowlist integration follow-up

Thanks Alice — Wed 7/21 9:30am PT is confirmed on our calendar.

Agenda for the 60-minute deep dive (proposed):
- 10m: Introductions & success criteria (Laurence / Alice)
- 20m: Networking & VPC endpoints (Jonas) — IP allowlist format, DNS, egress expectations, health checks
- 15m: Auth & SDK routing (Marissa) — mTLS options, cert provisioning/rotation, x-redwood-routing header and SDK config for embeddings/reranker routing
- 10m: Operational concerns (Lauren) — monitoring, rollout plan, rollback/fallback (hosted vs private)
- 5m: Next steps & ownership (action items)

Pre-call asks (please bring):
- FinPay egress IP list (CIDR or IPs)
- The internal proxy cert format and rotation policy
- Any internal DNS resolver behavior that might affect split-horizon CNAMEs

I'll also share a short tech checklist in the calendar invite and include the Redwood VPC guide link.

Best,
Lauren

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC endpoints / IP allowlist integration follow-up

Quick internal note after a prep run:

- I'll bring a summary slide with: required firewall rules, recommended TCP ports (443 + health-check ports), and the exact JSON we will need from FinPay for all allowlist entries.
- For mTLS: we support mutual TLS with client certs presented at the connection via Envoy; acceptable formats: PEM chain and PKCS12. If they prefer cert-manager, we can accept a public key/cert signing request flow and support rotation every 90 days.
- For embeddings routing: we'll ask them to set x-redwood-routing: finpay-prod on SDK calls. Marissa, can you confirm SDK config snippet to set that header and token scoping for the private model variant so I can include it in the slide?

I'll sync with you both 30m before the FinPay call to run through slides.

-Jonas
